key_insight: VAE-NLME combines neural posterior approximation with importance weighting to converge almost surely to stationary points of the marginal log-likelihood.
engineering_relevance: The method provides a convergence-backed route to integrating neural components into nonlinear mixed-effects models used for dose selection and individualized dosing.
method: Use a neural encoder to amortize posterior approximation in nonlinear mixed-effects models.
Prove ELBO-based convergence to ELBO stationary points without exact encoder training.
Use the encoder as a proposal for importance-weighted sufficient statistics to obtain likelihood-stationary convergence without assumptions on encoder training.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports almost-sure convergence proofs for two algorithm variants, but gives no datasets or empirical performance results.
watch_item: Convergence to stationary points does not guarantee a global maximum or establish practical convergence speed.
paper_title: From the ELBO to Maximum Likelihood: Convergence of Variational Autoencoders for Nonlinear Mixed-Effects Modeling
